- Files opened from the notification (a zip) keeps its own look (it was drawn dark on black).
- Control Panel window: dark glass title bar (no accent), a hairline address bar and a rounded search box with a hint.
- QR reader: after a refused camera permission the app's permission page opens; the Toolkit's QR reader and Floating keyboard have their own colour icons.
- Keyboard: Shift + key (hold Shift with one finger, tap a key with another) types the key's extra character (a setting, on at first); a text pasted from the clipboard panel leaves the bar and is not offered again.
- Terminal: the notification of an open session has the >_ icon.
- Launcher: the DNS page in a window no longer draws its cards on top of each other; the Windows 11 taskbar buttons stop short of the tray and scroll; Windows 10 windows are black; the launcher's home-screen icon is on pure black.
